Container.Name: CNGI-Trades
Container.Overview: CNGI Trades private family trading workspace. Zero required setup variables: initializes a local database and secrets in appdata. Configure Authentik later through /setup; family access is managed in Authentik, and brokerage accounts are connected separately by each user. Trading is disabled in this foundation release.
Container.Requires: Unraid port 8191 and persistent appdata /data. Optional private GHCR login for pulling Docker image.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port 8191 for the dashboard, proxy to this port later.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent local database, encryption key and setup settings. Back up the whole folder, including hidden files.

Config.Name: Public Trades URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS URL for Authentik callback and secure login cookies. Normally leave as is.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Advanced: IP addresses of trusted reverse proxies. Do not set to wildcard.

Config.Name: Optional PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Advanced optional external database for new installs; leave blank for local SQLite. Changing later does not migrate data automatically.
